title: The Old Man Neither Boy Heard — Part 1

series.summary: Gon and Killua share a personal conversation aboard the airship. Netero interrupts without either boy noticing his approach. His unexplained arrival introduces the strength gap that the ball challenge will expose.

segments.voiceover_text: How does someone sneak up on two boys this alert? Before that shock, Gon and Killua enjoy a quiet conversation above the clouds. Killua talks about his family. His expression grows thoughtful. For a moment, their friendship matters more than the exam.
Then Killua's teasing confidence returns. Gon smiles back. Their conversation feels easy again. Neither boy is braced for an interruption. That comfortable moment is about to break.
Netero is suddenly right beside them. Both boys turn. Killua looks startled. How did this old man get so close without either of them noticing?
